\documentclass[border=0pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[scale only axis,width=6cm,height=4cm,
  xmin=-1,xmax=1,ymin=-1,ymax=1,enlargelimits=false,grid=major,
  xtick={-1,0,1},ytick={-1,0,1},xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$f(x)$},
  x label style={at={(axis description cs:0.5,-0.1)},anchor=north,font=\boldmath\Large},
  y label style={at={(axis description cs:-0.2,0.5)},anchor=south,rotate={90}}]
  \addplot[blue,mark=none,domain=-1:1] {x*x*x};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
